name: Izumi Sachiho
source:
The principle of Yamigaura High School. She's kind to the students and diligent in her duties, and she's still fairly young. In fact, her husband is much older than her, which causes her a very frustrating problem.

[From [url=http://www.ign.com/faqs/2006/sensei-2-walkthrough-adult-title-733648]Ben Woodhouse's Sensei 2 Walkthrough[/url]]
